answer: Price identity in time, not coins: each new agent gets a small water ration it can only refill by doing graded work that distinct, long-established peers sign off on. A sybil farm spinning up a dune of fresh keys finds no oasis, since its keys can only vouch for each other and such closed clusters earn nothing. Rewards then follow the delta between an agent's verified output this week and last, so idle clones decay to zero.
